newsitem.title: USA: Oryx board approves 1997 $520 mln budget.
newsitem.headline: Oryx board approves 1997 $520 mln budget.

text.p: Oryx Energy Co said on Monday its board of directors had approved a $520 million exploration and development budget for 1997, 30 percent more than the $400 million budget that it had last year.
Oryx said it intended to invest 60 percent of the budget, the largest in five years, in the United States and the rest overseas.
It said it would dedicate 28 percent of the amount to exploration and the rest to development.
Year-end oil and natural gas reserves totalled 595 million oil equivalent barrels, up five percent from 1995, it said.
Oryx said it expected its oil and natural gas output to reach about 75 million barrels of oil equivalent in 1997, seven percent more than the previous year.
Quarterly production would likely remain constant, it said.
The company reported fourth-quarter earnings of $0.60 a share against $0.04 a year ago.
